idea: my cat Pip hops across cloud islands collecting lost kites
creator: Ahmed
title: Pip's Cloud Kite Hop

design.title: Pip's Cloud Kite Hop
design.tagline: Hold, bounce and flutter-float with Pip to bring every lost kite home!
design.story: Pip, a little blue cat in her fluffy cream cape, wakes to find the sky's kites blown loose. With her humming puff-chick friend, she hops across bouncy cloud islands and sleepy Lavender Hollow, catching every lost kite to tuck back into the cozy nest.

hero.name: Pip
hero.look: little round sky-blue cat with pointy ears, big kind eyes and tiny smile, thin yellow tail and tiny legs

world.setting: floating cloud islands stitched with bubble ponds and trailing kite strings above a lavender haze

specialMechanic.name: Flutter Float Hop
specialMechanic.howItWorks: Hold jump to squish down, release to bounce high. Hold again in air and Pip's cream cape flutters to float longer over gaps. Time releases for extra-soft landings.

levels.name: Breezy Scarf Meadows
levels.idea: Bouncy morning cloud tufts teach hold-release hops and first lost kites with chick hints.

levels.name: Lavender Hollow
levels.idea: Sleepy violet isles with slow drifting bubble ponds that lift Pip to high hidden kites.

verdict.summary: Pip runs, jumps, flutters and collects kites across cloud platforms, takes one hit and keeps playing with no errors.
verdict.seen: Screenshots show a bright pastel cloud world with platforms, kite pickups, a blue scarf hero, puff enemies, and a readable star, hearts, and tutorial HUD.

seasons.notes: Built Pip's Cloud Kite Hop with 2 day-lit cloud levels, kite collectibles, bouncy bubble pads, cape flutter float and early hint HUD.

verdict.summary: Pip runs, jumps and flutters across cloud platforms collecting kites, stomping a foe, taking one hit and reaching the checkpoint.
verdict.seen: Three bright day-sky screenshots show cloud platforms, kite pickups, blue bird hero, fluffy enemies, spikes, star score and hearts HUD, ending on a CHECKPOINT banner.

bugs.title: Checkpoint fires repeatedly while player stands on it
bugs.evidence: Event trail logs 18 checkpoint events from 8.7s to 9.0s while player stays near end; screenshot 3 shows CHECKPOINT banner stuck on, indicating re-trigger every frame.
bugs.fixHint: Debounce checkpoint to fire once on enter, requiring exit and re-enter before it can fire again.

proposal.title: Pip's Cloud Kite Hop Season 2
proposal.pitch: Pip, her puff-chick and a new moon-frog friend hop through a cozy blanket-sky night, using twirl boosts and kind retries to tuck every lost kite home.

changes.what: Cape twirl boost: tap jump in air for a soft twirl lift
changes.why: Helps reach high kites without frustration and keeps Pip's float gentle and cozy

changes.what: Retry from last cloud button after a slip
changes.why: Saves hopping all the way back and keeps slips kind for little players

changes.what: Sleepy moon-frog hums and points to nearby hidden kites
changes.why: Makes secrets findable with sound and gesture while staying calm and cozy
